summary.headline: Aries Decan Paranataellonta
summary.text: Paranatellonta, or stellar faces, for the first and second decans of Aries according to Persian and Indian traditions, including Cassiepeia, Andromeda, Perseus, the cynocephalus, and associated constellational figures. Editorial notes compare the Greek text with Arabic Apomasar and identify omissions by Ptolemy’s scribe.
